tasks.name: Bi-weekly Lead Funnel Progression Monitoring
tasks.description:
Review how leads from ads are moving through the funnel in LeadLock (from lead capture to tour bookings/conversations). Check both the ad performance and post-lead engagement. Touch base with the client on progress and any strategic adjustments needed.

Video walkthrough

tasks.name: Add noindex Tag to Funnel Header Code
tasks.description:
1. In HighLevel, open the funnel > Settings > Tracking Code > Header.
2. Paste exactly this line:
   <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">
3. Save, then publish the funnel.
4. Repeat for every funnel on the sub-account's domain. Header code applies per funnel, not per domain - one funnel can be tagged while another on the same domain is not.
5. Verify: open a live page, view page source (Cmd+Option+U / Ctrl+U), search for "robots". It must appear as name="robots". Or post the domain in the client Slack channel and tag @Viktor to check.

Do not use the SEO section's custom meta tag field (Name: Robots / Content: Noindex, nofollow). It outputs <meta property="Robots"> and Google ignores property=; only name= is honored. Confirmed on Ridgefield and The Penny, 8/21/26.

Note for client conversations: Google only acts on the tag at its next crawl, typically days to a few weeks. Confirming a page has actually dropped out of search, or forcing faster removal, requires Search Console access on that domain.
